messages:
Alex Rivera: heads-up — post-canary metrics for today's routing rollout are drifting. EU canaries showing a 3x increase in p95 token latency and ~2% 500s on inference path. noticed around ~10:12 UTC.
Maria Chen: seeing the same in dashboards. threads: per-route latency on /v1/generate-eu spiked, cpu/GPU look normal.
Kevin Patel: +1, logs show a mix of OOM-ish GC in worker logs and repeated 502 from model-proxy (not full host OOM).
SRE Bot: incident created: INC-2026-0279. Severity: SEV2. Paging eng-oncall.
Alex Rivera: @DeployBot did the canary finish?
DeployBot: canary finished at 10:06 UTC. 10% traffic to new routing policy (route-v2) — no automatic rollout.
Sophia Li: if route-v2 is routing to quantized variant, maybe kernel mismatch causing errors. do we have a recent quant toggle?
Maria Chen: we flipped feature flag `route_v2_active` at 09:55 during staged rollout. It routes EU traffic to model-variant q4 on dedicated pool.
Kevin Patel: quick check: `kubectl logs model-proxy-eu-*/proxy | tail -n 200` shows repeated stacktrace: `KVCacheEvictError: invalid slice length` then `upstream 502` bursts.
Alex Rivera: can we kill the flag immediately? that's fastest rollback path.
Maria Chen: issuing kill-switch now. `curl -X POST https://ff-service.internal/flags/route_v2_active/disable -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
DeployBot: feature flag `route_v2_active` disabled at 10:18:23 UTC by maria.
SRE Bot: note: automatic traffic funneling back to route-v1 in ~30s.
Customer Support: we have an open support ticket (SUP-3452) reporting higher latencies for EU customers, some timeouts.
Sophia Li: metrics recalculating — p95 dropped ~60% since kill switch, errors falling but still above baseline.
Kevin Patel: starting rollback plan B: scale down q4 variant pods and drain. `kubectl scale sts q4-variant-eu --replicas=0`.
Maria Chen: scale command accepted, draining. monitoring for 502s.
Alex Rivera: quick customer-impact note: INFO from Support: affected customers likely ~3% of EU requests; some retry logic mitigated user-visible failures but latency/UX degraded.
SRE Bot: paging note: oncall rotation — handing off to Kevin for next 30m while I join on infra checks.
Oncall Rotation: Kevin Patel is taking the active handoff at 10:22 UTC.
Kevin Patel: taking over. next steps: confirm no residual traffic to q4, verify model-proxy error logs tail to zero, and look for root-cause signals (kernel/quant mismatch or config drift).
Sophia Li: pulling kernel logs from inference nodes `journalctl -u inference-engine -n 500` — seeing `mismatched-kernel: attempted to load cpu_kernel_v3 for quantized op` warnings earlier.
Kevin Patel: that points to build-version mismatch between runtime and compiled kernels. who pushed the kernel artifacts? Maria?
Maria Chen: infra pipeline `build-inference-artifacts` ran at 09:40 and produced v3-kernels, but the deploy tag used was `route-v2-20260315` that pulls `v2-kernels`. looks like a tag mismatch in artifact ref.
Alex Rivera: ok that's congruent. immediate mitigation timeline: kill flag done, scaled q4 down, now monitoring for 10m to confirm stable. next: create postmortem action items (pin artifact hashes, add pre-rollout artifact checksum check).
Customer Support: updated SUP-3452: emailed affected customers with apology + temporary mitigation note; advising to retry after 10:30 UTC.
Kevin Patel: still see intermittent 502s at 10:25 — tracking connections: `ss -tnp | grep model-proxy` shows lingering upstream connections to q4 pods removed. will force-close after 10:28 if still alive.
Sophia Li: recommendation: add a CI gate that verifies kernel and runtime versions match for target tag (checksum compare).
Maria Chen: creating an emergency PR to add artifact checksum verification and a CI blocker for canary completion if mismatch detected. PR: internal link (PR-8679).
SRE Bot: reminder: collect traces for a sample of affected requests. `trace-collector --range 10:00-10:20 --filter route=/v1/generate-eu` — saved to /incidents/2791234567/traces.tgz
Alex Rivera: we should also run a quick smoke on canary variant in staging to reproduce kernel mismatch. Sophia, can you spin a single pod with v3-kernels + v2-runtime?
Sophia Li: will try in sandbox. `kubectl run repro-q4 --image=inference:v2-runtime --env KERNEL_ARTIFACT=v3-kernels` — hitting immediate kernel load warnings. reproduces locally.
Kevin Patel: for the handoff: I'll stay on for another 40m, will watch SLOs and confirm rollback completes. if errors persist escalate to SEV1.
Maria Chen: created incident page with timeline + mitigation steps at /incidents/2791234567. adding action items and owner tags.
Customer Support: logged a follow-up note to customers, created a status page entry draft (pending ops signoff).
Alex Rivera: summary for handoff: root likely artifact/tag mismatch -> caused kernel/runtime incompatibility on q4 quantized variant -> produced KV/cache errors -> 502s and latency spikes. mitigation: feature flag kill switch, scale down q4 pods, closed lingering connections, created PR for checksum gating, and notified customers.
SRE Bot: SEV2 -> monitoring mode. next update scheduled in 30m or on status change.
Oncall Rotation: Kevin Patel remains primary. If escalation needed ping @sre-lead and @platform-eng. :thumbsup:
Kevin Patel: acknowledged. will post final resolution and assign postmortem owner after stability window.
Alex Rivera: thanks team — keep short updates in thread.
